data.one_liner: Flutter package to create and manage selectable time slot grids and calculate day parts.
data.what_it_does: Provides widgets for displaying time slots in a grid view generated from intervals or a list of DateTimes. It also includes utility functions to determine the day part name of a given time with localization support.
use_when: You need to display a grid of time slots for booking or scheduling appointments
You need to generate time slots based on a start time, end time, and interval
You need to partition time into day parts with localization support
avoid_when: You need full calendar views with events and month/week displays
You require complex recurring appointment rules
strengths: Supports grid views generated from both intervals and date lists
Includes support for multiple selection and disabled time slots
Supports localization for Arabic and English
weaknesses: Limited to two languages (ar and en) out of the box
Not a full calendar or scheduling solution
